notes: With several default routes (Ethernet + Wi-Fi, or a VPN route), the app now pings the gateway Windows actually uses — the lowest-metric one.
patch_notes: When your PC has more than one default route — Ethernet and Wi-Fi both up, or a VPN's own default route — Windows sends traffic through the lowest-metric one. The app used to ping the first 0.0.0.0 row in `route print`, which is not necessarily that gateway, so the bare-vs-blocked verdict could be decided against a gateway that is not carrying your traffic. It now picks the lowest-metric gateway from the Active Routes section (persistent routes never count, and a row with an unreadable metric only wins when it is alone). On a normal single-route machine nothing changes. Covered by new test round 27.
